job_description: Local retail chain seeks a Retail Manager to run a busy store. Mandatory: (M1) 5+ years retail management experience; (M2) Proven people management and rostering skills; (M3) Experience managing stock and inventory systems; (M4) Ability to achieve sales targets and produce weekly sales reports. Preferred: (P1) Experience with point-of-sale (POS) systems; (P2) Experience running local marketing or community engagement. The job values leadership, loss-prevention awareness and customer-service orientation.
candidate_profile: Candidate has 3 years as assistant store manager and 2 years running a small independent boutique (total 5 years). Managed teams of 6–10 staff, created rosters, handled stock ordering using a simple inventory spreadsheet, and ran occasional local promotions. Claims strong sales leadership. No formal POS system experience beyond basic till operation.
